citations.label: Artificial Analysis, Kimi K3 model page
citations.excerpt: Kimi K3 scores 57 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, ranking #4 / 186. Output speed: 35.2 Output tokens per second. Price: $3.00 per 1M tokens input, $15.00 per 1M tokens output. Open weights: No, Kimi K3 is proprietary. The model weights are not publicly available.

citations.label: Simon Willison, hands-on with Kimi K3
citations.excerpt: The new model is notable for the pricing: $3/million input tokens and $15/million output tokens. An open weight release is promised 'by July 27, 2026'.

citations.label: Nathan Lambert, Interconnects
citations.excerpt: K3 is a 2.8T parameter MoE model which will have its weights released on July 27th. It will be the closest open models have been to the frontier since DeepSeek R1.
